title: Bike chain cleaned and lubricated
description: Replace a bicycle chain: chain new and seated, tension correct, drivetrain lubricated, work area tidy.

criteria.label: Chain is new/clean and fully seated on the sprockets
Chain tension looks correct (no excessive sag)
Drivetrain is lubricated without excess oil
Work area and bike left tidy

notes: MANUAL §9.5 bike case. Shoot the drivetrain from the same side, chain line filling the frame; code sticky note wired to the chain or taped to the frame in the AFTER shot.
